description: Bizagi Modeler dialect plugin (http://www.bizagi.com/schemas/2010/Bizagi). Imports Bizagi:BizagiExtensions/Bizagi:BizagiProperty name/value pairs into bizagi:* element property keys and exports them back as a BizagiExtensions payload. The Bizagi:property element ATTRIBUTE is normalized to the bizagi:property key by the importer's attribute catch-all and written back by this plugin's payload (round-trip stable).
